contests.title: Provincia de Tarapacá (PROVINCIA DE TARAPACA)
contests.notes: 1st agrupación. Table gives party votes only (V./M./T. = men/women/total); T. of the province total row transcribed. Areas are the department head communes as printed. Columns A Comandos Populares, C Conservador Unido, F Unión Nacional, H Demócrata, L Independiente print only dashes and are omitted. Registered and valid not printed. Elected deputies and their parties from p.48 (names as printed; no candidate votes printed).

contests.title: Provincia de Antofagasta (PROVINCIA DE ANTOFAGASTA)
contests.notes: 2nd agrupación. Source error: the province row prints Conservador Unido T. = 3704, but its V. 1786 + M. 918 = 2704, the department totals (1754+70+705+175) sum to 2704, and only with 2704 do the parties plus nulos y blancos (1799) equal the printed total general 48.198. The printed 3704 is kept. Columns A, F, H, L print only dashes and are omitted.

contests.title: Provincia Atacama (PROVINCIA ATACAMA)
contests.notes: 3rd agrupación (ordinal printed on p.53). Only four party columns printed for this province. The first elected name is printed '1.-mMANUEL MAGALHAES MEDLING' with a stray typed 'm', kept as printed.

contests.title: Provincia de Coquimbo (PROVINCIA COQUIMBO)
contests.notes: 4th agrupación. Province spans pp.7-10 (pp.7-8 first departments, pp.9-10 Illapel and the province row). Communist T. printed '.7574'.

contests.title: Provincia de Aconcagua (PROVINCIA DE ACONCAGUA)
contests.notes: 5th agrupación.

contests.title: Provincia de Valparaíso (PROVINCIA DE VALPARAISO)
contests.notes: 6th agrupación (Valparaíso y Quillota, ordinal printed on p.53). Scan pages are out of order: p.13 holds columns B-G, p.12 columns I-K, nulos y blancos (headed 'L.') and total general. Elected names on p.48 partly overtyped ('ASPEE' and 'REYES' struck over; read as shown).

contests.title: Santiago, Primer Distrito (TOTAL PRIMER DISTRITO)
contests.notes: 7th agrupación, 1st district (ordinal on p.53). Areas are the communes/subdelegations listed for the district. The total general row prints V. 108710 (last digit 0 or 8 unclear) and M. 67764; T. 176474 equals the sum of party totals plus nulos y blancos.

contests.title: Santiago, 2º Distrito (TOTAL 2º DISTRITO)
contests.notes: 7th agrupación, 2nd district. Areas: communes of the district plus the department of Talagante (Talagante, Peñaflor, Isla de Maipo, Maipú, Curacaví). The elected list on p.49 numbers the five names 1-4 and 6 (no 5).

contests.title: Santiago, 3er. Distrito (TOTAL 3er. DISTRITO)
contests.notes: 7th agrupación, 3rd district. Areas: communes of the district plus the department of Puente Alto (Puente Alto, Pirque, San José de Maipo).

contests.title: Santiago 4ª Agrupación (Melipilla, San Antonio, San Bernardo y Maipo) (TOTAL 4º DISTRITO)
contests.notes: Title from the elected list (p.49: 'SANTIAGO 4ª Agrupación ( Melipilla, San Antonio, San Bernardo y Maipo )'); the tables call this grouping 'TOTAL 4º DISTRITO' (pp.16-17). The tables also print a PROVINCIA DE SANTIAGO total over all four, not transcribed. Liberal and Democrático Nacional both total 8521 (5134+3387 and 5307+3214), re-read at 300 dpi.

contests.title: Provincia de O'Higgins (PROVINCIA DE O"HIGGINS)
contests.notes: 9th agrupación by sequence (ordinal not printed). Total general column headed 'TOTALES GENERALES'.

contests.title: Provincia de Colchagua (PROVINCIA DE COLCHAGUA)
contests.notes: Second department row printed 'DEPTO.COL.CRUZ' (Santa Cruz).

contests.title: Provincia Curicó (PROVINCIA CURICO)
contests.notes: Elected list prints the Socialist party as 'SOOIALISTA' (typo).

contests.title: Provincia de Talca (PROVINCIA DE TALCA)
contests.notes: The last party column on p.22 has no printed header (no letter or name); it is the column that the other provinces head 'I. Liberal' and is labelled Liberal here by that position (Talca elected a Liberal). p.23 column headed only 'K.' (Democrático Nacional elsewhere).

contests.title: Provincia Maule (PROVINCIA MAULE)
contests.notes: 13th agrupación (ordinal on p.53). Nulos y blancos printed only for the Cauquenes department (dashes elsewhere); province figure 180.

contests.title: Provincia de Linares (PROVINCIA DE LINARES)
contests.notes: The Socialist column on p.26 is headed only 'Socialista' (no letter). The Linares department subtotal row on p.26 has no label.

contests.title: Ñuble ( San Carlos e Itata ) (TOTAL CIRCUNSCRIPCION)
contests.notes: Title from the elected list (p.50); the table (p.27) labels the row 'TOTAL CIRCUNSCRIPCION'. The province of Ñuble elects in two groupings; the volume's 'TOTAL PROVINCIA ÑUBLE' row (pp.28-29) is not transcribed.

contests.title: Ñuble ( Chillán, Bulnes y Yungay ) (TOTAL CIRCUNSCRIPCION)
contests.notes: Title from the elected list (p.50); tables (pp.28-29) label the row 'TOTAL CIRCUNSCRIPCION'. Total general T. printed 35.017 is partly overwritten by a handwritten mark but legible; it equals the party totals plus nulos y blancos. The Comunista column (G.) prints dashes for this grouping.

contests.title: Provincia de Concepción (PROVINCIA DE CONCEPCION)
contests.notes: Socialist T. printed '11.226' with a blotted digit (V. 7521 + M. 3705 = 11226). Ruiz-Esquide's party printed '( CONSERVADOR )', assigned to the Conservador Unido column.

contests.title: Provincia de Arauco (PROVINCIA DE ARAUCO)
contests.notes: Includes a column 'L. Independiente' (2.720) that elected nobody.

contests.title: Provincia de Malleco (PROVINCIA DE MALLECO)
contests.notes: Elected name 5 printed 'CARLOS BIVORI ALZERRECA' (kept as printed).

contests.title: Provincia Cautín (PROVINCIA CAUTIN)
contests.notes: Includes 'A. Comandos Pop.' (96). Elected name 9 is blurred in the scan, read as 'SALVADOR MONROY PINTO'; Tuma's party printed 'DEMOCRATAICO NACIONAL' (typo).

contests.title: Provincia Valdivia (PROVINCIA VALDIVIA)
contests.notes: Source error: the province row prints Comunista T. = 3371, but V. 3230 + M. 1141 = 4371, the department totals (3811+357+203) sum to 4371, and only 4371 makes the columns add to the printed total general 41.905 (with 3371 they sum to 40.905). The printed 3371 is kept (re-read at 300 dpi).

contests.title: Provincia Osorno (PROVINCIA OSORNO)
contests.notes: The women-candidates table on p.53 calls Osorno the '22ª Agrup.'; first elected name read 'CARLOS FOLLERT FLEIDL' (heavy typeface).

contests.title: Llanquihue y Aysén (PROVINCIA DE LLANQUIHUE + PROVINCIA AYSEN)
contests.notes: One grouping ('LLANQUIHUE Y AYSEN' in the elected list, p.52) printed as two province tables with no grouping total. All figures here are COMPUTED sums of the printed province rows: Llanquihue (pp.43-44: DC 2723, CU 5915, Rad 6682, Com 1979, Lib 4665, Soc 2486, nulos y blancos 1210, total general 25.660) + Aysén (p.45, row 'PROVINCIA AYSEN' at about [0.18,0.79,0.9,0.83]: DC 397, CU 874, Rad 1254, Com 680, Lib 758, Soc 699, nulos y blancos 291, total general 4953). List boxes point at the Llanquihue figures; the Aysén addends are on p.45.

contests.title: Provincia Chiloé (PROVINCIA CHILOE)
contests.notes: Department rows printed 'DEPTO.ANCUD', 'DEPTO.CASTRO', 'DEPTO. QUINCHAO', 'DEPTO. PALENA'.

contests.title: Provincia Magallanes (PROVINCIA MAGALLANES)
contests.notes: Province table is on p.47 (upper half B-G, lower half H-L, nulos, total). Ultima Esperanza department label is handwritten. Radical V. printed 4850 (or 4860; blurred) with M. 3756 and T. 8616; T. agrees with the department rows. Only one deputy is listed as elected for Magallanes on p.52; seats = 1 as printed.

notes: Volume: Elección Parlamentaria 1961 (deputies), tables of party votes by province/department/commune with V./M./T. (men/women/total) columns, pp.2-47; list of elected deputies by grouping, pp.48-52; table of women candidates and elected by agrupación, p.53. Election day printed on p.1 cover as 'Domingo 5 de Marzo.- 1961.-'. No candidate votes, no registered voters and no separate valid/null/blank figures are printed: lists are parties (T. column at grouping level), candidates are the elected deputies only (votes null), null_blank is 'Nulos y Blancos', cast is 'TOTAL GENERAL'. Party columns that print only dashes for a grouping are omitted. Contest numbers are the sequence in the volume; printed ordinals on p.53 (3a Atacama, 6a Valparaíso y Quillota, 7a Santiago 1-3 distritos, 13a Maule, 14a Linares, 18a Arauco, 22a Osorno) agree with this sequence up to Arauco, but p.53 calls Osorno 22a whereas it is the 23rd grouping here. Province totals of Santiago (all four districts) and Ñuble (both groupings) are printed but not transcribed as contests. National: the TOTAL GENERAL row on p.47 gives party totals; their sum plus nulos y blancos (45.780) is 1.385.674 vs printed total general 1.385.676 (difference 2 in the source). Two province rows contain party totals that disagree with their own V.+M. and with the total general (Antofagasta CU 3704 for 2704; Valdivia Comunista 3371 for 4371); printed values kept, explained in contest notes.
